idea: Short clip #2 of the Friday long song 'Bubble on My Nose!' (JIMMY'S ROOM): the ears verse – a soap bubble floats by Baby Jimmy's ears ('Pop! A bubble by my ears! These are my ears! Touch your ears with me! Listen, listen! Ears, ears, ears! I can hear!') – then the second chorus with Jimmy standing and dancing ('Nose and ears, tummy and toes! Touch them, touch them, here we go!' … 'Boop, boop, boop! My little nose!'). Learning: body part EARS (+ chorus nose, ears, tummy, toes); copy-me touch your ears.
title: Pop! A Bubble by My Ears! 👂 Listen with Baby Jimmy | Learn Body Parts | Crayon Babies
description:
Pop! A shiny soap bubble floats right by Baby Jimmy's ears! 👂 Touch your ears with Baby Jimmy in his cozy bedroom, listen, listen, and sing the body parts chorus: nose and ears, tummy and toes!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Pop! A bubble by my ears!"
👂 "These are my ears!" – touch your ears with Jimmy!
👂 Listen, listen! Ears, ears, ears – I can hear!
🎵 Sing and dance the chorus – nose and ears, tummy and toes!
👃 Boop, boop, boop! My little nose!

📚 Kids learn: body parts • ears • English words: ears, touch, listen, hear • chorus words: nose, ears, tummy, toes

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along body parts clip for toddlers and preschoolers – touch your ears, listen, and sing along with Baby Jimmy to learn body parts in English.

Kids songs • Nursery rhymes • Body parts song • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning • Preschool learning • Kids cartoon
